Short answer

To install pinta on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add pinta. It is a 7.2 MB download (21 MB installed), version 3.1.2-1, licensed MIT. Drawing/editing program modeled after Paint.NET. It's goal is to provide a simplified alternative to GIMP for casual users. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install pinta on Omarchy

Pinta is a free, open-source drawing and image-editing program for Linux, Mac, Windows and *BSD, modeled after the discontinued Paint.NET. It offers straightforward tools for freehand drawing, selection, cropping and resizing, over 35 real-time-preview effects and adjustments, layer support, and unlimited undo — aiming to be a simpler, more approachable alternative to heavyweight editors like GIMP for casual users.

Watch: Pinta 2.0.1 - Drawing & Image Editor for Linux, macOS, & Windows Users ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add pinta
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 3.1.2-1:
    pacman -Qi pinta

Open and use pinta

pinta is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql pinta | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install pinta on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add pinta. The download is 7.2 MB and it takes 21 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is pinta free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall pinta?

Run omarchy pkg drop pinta. It removes the package from your system.

What does pinta depend on?

The package declares 5 dependencies: dotnet-runtime, dotnet-host, libadwaita, hicolor-icon-theme, webp-pixbuf-loader. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is pinta a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for pinta.

Is pinta in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as pinta (version 3.1.2-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Pinta contributors makes it. Project site: https://pinta-project.com.
